blocks.text: Team preview of the Minnesota Timberwolves ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 49-33, lost to San Antonio in second round of playoffs. Coach: Chris Finch (seventh season, 258-193). Season opener: Oct. 21 at Miami. Departures: F Julius Randle, F/C Naz Reid, G Mike Conley, F Kyle Anderson, F Joe Ingles. Additions: G LaMelo Ball, F Jonathan Kuminga, F Cody Williams, F Trey Lyles, G Isaiah Evans.
